newsitem.title: UK: U.K. TIN MINE TO CLOSE - PA.
newsitem.headline: U.K. TIN MINE TO CLOSE - PA.

text.p: The South Crofty tin mine in Cornwall, England, is to close down, the U.K. Press Association (PA) said.
South Crofty is the last remaining tin mine in the U.K., and 270 jobs will be lost it was announced on Thursday, the PA said.
Managers announced the closure at an emergency meeting on Thursday morning.
The company blamed the decision on the falling price of tin on the world market and the strengthening of sterling against the dollar, the PA said.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
